bio.text: Josh Smead is the Democratic nominee for Missouri's 6th Congressional District, nominated in the August 4, 2026 primary.
He is an architect from Liberty, Missouri.
He has not held office before.

sources.title: Missouri 6th Congressional District voter guide: Stigall, Smead and Maidment
Who's running for Missouri's 6th District? It now includes more of the Northland and Kansas City
